question: For subnets whose network has a RBAC action of 'access_as_shared' and whose RBAC target tenant is '1ee6b5b4fe8c45cfa16c3ecdbb8ee02b', find each IP version and the maximum running sum of subnet standard attribute IDs (computed within each IP version group ordered by standard attribute ID). Do not return any rounded answers.

prediction.sql:
SELECT s.ip_version, MAX(running_sum) AS max_running_sum
FROM (
  SELECT s2.ip_version,
         SUM(s2.standard_attr_id) OVER (PARTITION BY s2.ip_version ORDER BY s2.standard_attr_id) AS running_sum
  FROM subnets s2
  JOIN networks n ON n.id = s2.network_id
  JOIN networkrbacs r ON r.object_id = n.id
  WHERE r.action = 'access_as_shared'
    AND r.target_tenant = '1ee6b5b4fe8c45cfa16c3ecdbb8ee02b'
) s
GROUP BY s.ip_version
